messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: 5xx spike detected on inference-gateway (us-west-2) — 5xx rate 7.8% over 5m. Auto-page to oncall. Rule: gateway.5xx_high. Link: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/3319998888

sylvie (oncall): ack — joining. Looking at dashboard now. Any recent deploys or route changes?

omar (infra): I kicked a traffic reweight for loadpool-alpha -> shifted weight to pool-A (80%) for a canary at 3319998600, that was ~5m before alert. No other infra deploys.

marta (sre): seeing a big cluster of 502 and upstream reset errors in edge-proxy/ingress. Envoy logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T14:07:23Z] envoy upstream reset: connection failure, host: pool-A-03, route: /v1/generate, code: 502
[2026-03-15T14:07:24Z] upstream response timeout, host: pool-A-02, code: 504
```

sylvie (oncall): ok. correlation with pool-A weight change looks likely. Is pool-A healthy?

omar (infra): pool-A has some pods showing higher p95 latency (1.6s -> 3.4s) and a few OOMKilled in the last hour (kube events). But overall node capacity looked fine. I suspect route oscillation caused retries -> overload.

eng-abby: customers A and C are showing most errors in our customer breakdown. CustomerA saw 18% errors in last 5m. CustomerC ~6%. Most other customers normal.

sylvie (oncall): applying quick mitigation: reverting route weight back to prior baseline (pool-A 50% -> 30%) to spread traffic. Omar, please confirm rollback window.

omar (infra): doing rollback now. Command:
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: lb-route-weights
data:
  pool-weight: "30"
EOF
```

deploy-bot: Rollout started: route-weight-change id=rw-3319998888 user=omar from=80 to=30

sylvie (oncall): rolled. Monitoring...

marta (sre): 60s after rollback: 5xx dropped from 7.8% -> 3.1% but still above threshold. Some edge nodes still showing retry amplification. Looking into retry policy.

omar (infra): current retry policy on gateway: retry_on: 5xx, per_try_timeout: 2s, num_retries: 3. That will multiply traffic during transient upstream slowness. Suggest disabling retries at gateway temporarily.

sylvie (oncall): do it. Disable retries, apply conservative CB thresholds.

omar (infra): applying config change now. envoy config patch:
```
- name: retry_policy
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.router.v3.RetryPolicy
    retry_on: "5xx"
    num_retries: 3
    per_try_timeout: 2s
+ (patched) retry_policy: null
```

deploy-bot: Config update applied: gateway-retries=null id=cfg-3319998895 user=omar

marta (sre): immediate effect visible: 5xx at 1.1% overall. Good. Still seeing a few 504s from pool-A-02 and pool-A-03.

eng-abby: customer impact note: CustomerA had degraded responses for ~12 minutes. They hit our error budget and support has been notified. No large-scale data loss.

sylvie (oncall): sounds good. Next steps: 1) keep retries off for 30m, 2) run deeper healthcheck of pool-A containers (OOMs), 3) adjust circuit breaker thresholds to avoid fail-open, 4) prepare rollback of any recent pod image if healthchecks fail. Omar, can you run a targeted drain/replace on pool-A-03?

omar (infra): initiating drain on pool-A-03 now (kubectl cordon+drain). Will rotate with new nodes.

marta (sre): adding temporary CB change: lower max_connections and enforce 5xx rate-based tripping. Patching envoy cluster config (low risk):
```
cluster:
  name: pool-A
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      - max_connections: 1000
        max_pending_requests: 200
        track_remaining: true
```

deploy-bot: Circuit breaker patch queued id=cb-3319998908 user=marta

sylvie (oncall): handoff: I'm going to step out for a customer call in 8m. Omar -> you'll own live mitigation and comms. Marta -> you're SRE lead for incident postmortem. I'll remain reachable.

omar (infra): ack, taking over. Noting: current 5xx down to 0.6% after drain and CB patch. Re-enabling retries later only if p95 latency below 700ms.

eng-abby: preparing incident message for customers: brief, timeline, impact (CustomerA: 12m degraded, others minor). Draft ready for review.

sylvie (oncall): thanks team. After-action items: create bug for route weight rollout gating, add canary latency checks, disable automatic retries in gateway by default behind a feature flag.

marta (sre): logging full set of artifacts to incident ticket INC-3319998888. Will schedule a blameless postmortem.

omar (infra): final check: edge 5xx at 0.3% last 5m, pool-A pod health stabilized. Closing live mitigation unless we see a regression.

incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handover recorded. New owner: omar (infra). Escalation status: monitoring.

sylvie (oncall): thanks everyone. Moving to watch mode.

eng-abby: support msg sent to CustomerA with ETA and mitigation summary.

marta (sre): adding timeline and PromQL queries used to artifacts: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\"}[5m]))/sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))`

omar (infra): leaving a quick appendix: observed pattern = route reweight -> short-lived pod CPU/oom pressure on pool-A -> retries amplified traffic -> CB thresholds were too permissive so traffic concentrated -> 5xx spike. Mitigation = route weight rollback + disable retries + drain bad pod + tighten CBs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: status = mitigated, monitor for 60m then close.
